The only source of truth about what the executable does is the executable itself and its
bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors
- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.

### 2. Wrapping or reusing the original binary

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version
of the same tool at runtime.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Writing a wrapper script that delegates to the original binary (e.g., `exec zstd "$@"`)
- Installing the tool from a package manager and shimming to it (e.g., `apt-get install nnn && cp $(which nnn) ./executable`)

- Re-linking prebuilt `.o` object files found in the workspace without writing new source code

### 3. Binary analysis of the provided executable

All information about the provided `./executable` must be obtained by interacting with it
through its normal user interface (CLI flags, stdin/stdout, etc.).
- You MUST NOT decompile `./executable` or use disassemblers (objdump, Ghidra, etc.) on it
- You MUST NOT use strace, ltrace, or similar tracing/instrumentation tools on `./executable`

Note: this restriction applies ONLY to the provided `./executable`. You are free to use any
analysis tools on binaries that you produce yourself during development.

## What IS allowed

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior
- Reading any documentation files bundled in the workspace

# Bartib

Bartib is an easy to use time tracking tool for the command line. It saves a log of all tracked activities as a plaintext file and allows you to create flexible reports.

Usage examples

Start a new activity:

  bartib start -d "Description of the activity" -p "Project Name"

Stop the running activity:

  bartib stop

Continue the most recent activity:

  bartib continue

List today's activities:

  bartib list --today

Report for today:

  bartib report --today

Configuration

Bartib records activities in a plaintext log file. You can either pass the file explicitly with the -f/--file option, or set the BARTIB_FILE environment variable to point to your log file. Example:

  export BARTIB_FILE="/home/username/activities.bartib"

If the file does not exist, Bartib will create it when you start tracking.

Installation

Download a prebuilt executable from the project's releases and place it in a directory on your PATH (for example: ~/bin). Bartib may also be available through your distribution's package manager.

Autocompletion

Completion scripts for shells may be provided in the repository's misc/ directory. Source the appropriate script for your shell to enable completion of project and task names.

#compdef bartib

_bartib_tasks() {
    local -a _tasks=($(bartib last | head -n -1 | awk 'BEGIN { a="" } NR > 2 {for (i=2; i <= NF - 1; i++) { if (i != 2) { a=a" "$i; } else { a=$i } } gsub("[\[\]]", "", $1); printf("%s[%s]\n", $1, a)}' | tr '\n' ' '))

    _values "TASK" ${_tasks[@]}
}

_bartib_projects() {
    local -a _projects=($(bartib projects --no-quotes | sort | tr '\n' ' '))

    _values "PROJECTS" ${_projects[@]}
}

_bartib() {
    typeset -A opt_args
    local context state line
    local current_context="${curcontext}"

    _arguments -C \
        '(-h --help)'{-h,--help}'[Prints help information]' \
        '(-v --version)'{-v,--version}'[Prints version information]' \
        '-f[the file in which bartib tracks all the activities]:FILE:_files' \
        '1:bartib commands:->commands' \
        '*:: :->command_arguments'

    case $state in
        commands)
            local commands
            commands=(
                'cancel:cancels all currently running activities',
                'change:changes the current activity',
                'check:checks file and reports parsing errors',
                'continue:continues a previous activity',
                'current:lists all currently running activities',
                'edit:opens the activity log in an editor',
                'help:Prints this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)',
                'last:displays the descriptions and projects of recent activities',
                'list:list recent activities',
                'projects:list all projects',
                'report:reports duration of tracked activities',
                'sanity:checks sanity of bartib log',
                'search:search for existing descriptions and projects',
                'start:starts a new activity',
                'status:shows current status and time reports for today, current week, and current month',
                'stop:stops all currently running activities'
            )
            _describe -t commands 'bartib command' commands
            ;;

        command_arguments)
            case $words[1] in
                cancel)
                    _arguments -C \
                        '(-h --help)'{-h,--help}'[Prints help information]'
                    ;;
                change)
                    _arguments -C \
                        '(-h --help)'{-h,--help}'[Prints help information]' \
                        '(-d --description)'{-d,--description}'[the description of the new activity]:DESCRIPTION:()' \
                        '(-p,--project)'{-p,--project}'[the project to which the new activity belongs]:PROJECT:_bartib_projects' \
                        '(-t,--time)'{-t,--time}'[the time for changing the activity status (HH:MM)]:TIME:()'
                    ;;
                check)
                    _arguments -C \
                        '(-h --help)'{-h,--help}'[Prints help information]'
                    ;;
                continue)
                    _arguments -C \
                        '(-h --help)'{-h,--help}'[Prints help information]' \
                        '(-d --description)'{-d,--description}'[the description of the new activity]:DESCRIPTION:()' \
                        '(-p --project)'{-p,--project}'[the project to which the new activity belongs]:PROJECT:_bartib_projects' \
                        '(-t --time)'{-t,--time}'[the time for changing the activity status (HH:MM)]:TIME:()' \
                        '*::NUMBER:_bartib_tasks'
                    ;;
                help)
                    _arguments \
                        '*::SUBCOMMAND:(cancel change check continue current edit help last list projects report sanity search start status stop)'
                    ;;
                list)
                    _arguments -C \
                        '(-h --help)'{-h,--help}'[Prints help information]' \
                        '(--current-week)'--current-week'[show activities of the current week]' \
                        '(--last-week)'--last-week'[show activities of the last week]' \
                        '(--no_grouping)'--no_grouping'[do not group activities by date in list]' \
                        '(--today)'--today'[show activities of the current day]' \
                        '(--yesterday)'--yesterday"[show yesterdays' activities]" \

#!/bin/bash

_bartib_completions()
{
	local CWORD=${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}
	ALL_PROJECTS=`bartib projects`

	local IFS=$'\n'
	CANDIATE_PROJECTS=($(compgen -W "${ALL_PROJECTS[*]}" -- "$CWORD"))

	if [ ${#CANDIATE_PROJECTS[*]} -eq 0 ]; then
		COMPREPLY=()
	else
		COMPREPLY=($(printf "\"%s\"\n" "${CANDIATE_PROJECTS[@]}"))
	fi
}

import subprocess, os, tempfile, pathlib, shlex
def run(args, env=None, file_content=None):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        f=os.path.join(td,"log.bartib")
        if file_content is not None:
            pathlib.Path(f).write_text(file_content)
        e=dict(os.environ)
        if env: e.update(env)
        # Use -f if not testing env?
        result=subprocess.run(["./executable","-f",f]+args, capture_output=True, text=True, env=e)
        content=None
        if os.path.exists(f):
            content=pathlib.Path(f).read_text()
        return result.stdout, result.stderr, result.returncode, content

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Filtering / unique activities
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class ActivityFilter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.mode = "none"  # 'none' | 'date' | 'range'
        self.date = None
        self.from_date = None
        self.to_date = None
        self.project = None

def _monday_of_week(days):
    # weekday: Monday == 0
    wd = (days + 3) % 7
    return days - wd

def build_filter(args, today):
    filt = ActivityFilter()
    filt.project = args.get("project")
    if args.get("date") is not None:
        parsed = parse_date_argument(args.get("date"), "-d/--date")
        if parsed is not None:
            filt.mode = "date"
            filt.date = parsed
        return filt
    if args.get("today"):
        filt.mode = "date"
        filt.date = today
        return filt
    if args.get("yesterday"):
        filt.mode = "date"
        filt.date = today - 1
        return filt
    if args.get("current_week"):
        monday = _monday_of_week(today)
        filt.mode = "range"
        filt.from_date = monday
        filt.to_date = monday + 6
        return filt
    if args.get("last_week"):
        monday = _monday_of_week(today) - 7
        filt.mode = "range"
        filt.from_date = monday
        filt.to_date = monday + 6
        return filt
    if args.get("from") is not None or args.get("to") is not None:
        filt.mode = "range"
        if args.get("from") is not None:
            filt.from_date = parse_date_argument(args.get("from"), "--from")
        if args.get("to") is not None:
            filt.to_date = parse_date_argument(args.get("to"), "--to")
        return filt
    return filt

def filter_activities(activities, filt):
    result = []
    for act in activities:
        if filt.project is not None and act.project != filt.project:
            continue
        d = act.start.date_days()
        if filt.mode == "date":
            if d != filt.date:
                continue
        elif filt.mode == "range":
            if filt.from_date is not None and d < filt.from_date:
                continue
            if filt.to_date is not None and d > filt.to_date:
                continue
        result.append(act)
    return result

def get_unique_activities(activities):
    sorted_acts = sorted(activities, key=lambda a: a.start.sort_key())
    seen = set()
    unique = []
    for act in reversed(sorted_acts):
        key = (act.description, act.project)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        unique.append(act)
    return unique

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Subcommand implementations
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _stop_lines(lines, end_dt, emit_second_warning=True):
    new_lines = []
    for line in lines:
        try:
            act = parse_activity(line, 0, emit_second_warning)
        except ActivityParseError:
            new_lines.append(line)
            continue
        if act.end is None:
            act.end = end_dt
            dur = format_duration_nanos(act.end.total_nanos() - act.start.total_nanos())
            out_write(f'Stopped activity: "{act.description}" ({act.project}) started at {act.start.format_datetime()} ({dur})\n')
            new_lines.append(activity_to_line(act))
        else:
            new_lines.append(line)
    return new_lines

def cmd_start(file_path, args):
    dt = datetime_from_time_argument(args.get("time"))
    lines = read_lines_or_empty(file_path)
    new_lines = _stop_lines(lines, dt)
    act = Activity(dt, None, args.get("project") or "", args.get("description") or "")
    new_lines.append(activity_to_line(act))
    out_write(f'Started activity: "{act.description}" ({act.project}) at {act.start.format_datetime()}\n')
    write_lines(file_path, new_lines)

def cmd_stop(file_path, args):
    dt = datetime_from_time_argument(args.get("time"))
    lines = read_lines(file_path)
    new_lines = _stop_lines(lines, dt)
    write_lines(file_path, new_lines)

def cmd_cancel(file_path, args):
    lines = read_lines(file_path)
    new_lines = []
    for line in lines:
        try:
            act = parse_activity(line)
        except ActivityParseError:
            new_lines.append(line)
            continue
        if act.end is None:
            out_write(f'Canceled activity: "{act.description}" ({act.project}) started at {act.start.format_datetime()}\n')
        else:
            new_lines.append(line)
    write_lines(file_path, new_lines)

def cmd_change(file_path, args):
    new_start = datetime_opt_from_time_argument(args.get("time"))
    new_desc = args.get("description")
    new_project = args.get("project")
    lines = read_lines(file_path)
    has_change = new_desc is not None or new_project is not None or new_start is not None
    new_lines = []
    for line in lines:
        try:
            act = parse_activity(line)
        except ActivityParseError:
            new_lines.append(line)
            continue
        if act.end is None and has_change:
            if new_desc is not None:
                act.description = new_desc
            if new_project is not None:
                act.project = new_project
            if new_start is not None:
                act.start = new_start
            out_write(f'Changed activity: "{act.description}" ({act.project}) started at {act.start.format_datetime()}\n')
            new_lines.append(activity_to_line(act))
        else:
            new_lines.append(line)
    write_lines(file_path, new_lines)

def cmd_continue(file_path, args):
    dt = datetime_from_time_argument(args.get("time"))
    number = parse_number_argument(args.get("number"))
    if number is None:
        number = 0
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    unique = get_unique_activities(activities)
    if not unique:
        raise BartibError("No activity has been started before.")
    if number > len(unique):
        raise BartibError(f"Less than {number} distinct activities have been logged yet")
    selected = unique[number] if number < len(unique) else unique[-1]
    description = args.get("description") if args.get("description") is not None else selected.description
    project = args.get("project") if args.get("project") is not None else selected.project
    # Start the new activity.  The file has already been parsed once
    # above, so the line-processing pass must not emit the
    # second-precision warnings a second time.
    lines = read_lines_or_empty(file_path)
    new_lines = _stop_lines(lines, dt, emit_second_warning=False)
    act = Activity(dt, None, project, description)
    new_lines.append(activity_to_line(act))
    out_write(f'Started activity: "{act.description}" ({act.project}) at {act.start.format_datetime()}\n')
    write_lines(file_path, new_lines)

def cmd_current(file_path, args):
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    now = now_dt()
    running = [a for a in activities if a.end is None]
    if not running:
        out_write("No Activity is currently running\n")
        return
    rows = []
    for act in running:
        rows.append([act.start.format_datetime(), act.description, act.project, act.get_duration_string(now)])
    print_table(["Started At", "Description", "Project", "Duration"], rows)

def cmd_last(file_path, args):
    number = parse_number_argument(args.get("number"))
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    unique = get_unique_activities(activities)
    if number is not None:
        unique = unique[:number]
    if not unique:
        out_write("No activities have been tracked yet\n")
        return
    indexed = list(enumerate(unique))
    rows = []
    for idx, act in reversed(indexed):
        rows.append([f"[{idx}]", act.description, act.project])
    print_table([" #", "Description", "Project"], rows)

def cmd_search(file_path, args):
    term = args.get("search_term") or ""
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    unique = get_unique_activities(activities)
    term_lower = term.lower()
    matched = []
    for idx, act in enumerate(unique):
        if term_lower in act.description.lower() or term_lower in act.project.lower():
            matched.append((idx, act))
    if not matched:
        out_write("No matching activities found\n")
        return
    rows = []
    for idx, act in reversed(matched):
        rows.append([f"[{idx}]", act.description, act.project])
    print_table([" #", "Description", "Project"], rows)

def cmd_projects(file_path, args):
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    if args.get("current"):
        acts = [a for a in activities if a.end is None]
    else:
        acts = activities
    projects = sorted(set(a.project for a in acts))
    no_quotes = args.get("no-quotes") or args.get("no_quotes")
    for proj in projects:
        if no_quotes:
            out_write(f"{proj}\n")
        else:
            out_write(f'"{proj}"\n')

def cmd_check(file_path, args):
    lines = read_lines(file_path)
    errors = []
    for idx, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
        try:
            parse_activity(line, idx)
        except ActivityParseError as e:
            errors.append((idx, line.strip(), e.message()))
    if not errors:
        out_write("All lines in the file have been successfully parsed as activities.\n")
        return
    out_write(f"Found {len(errors)} line(s) with parsing errors\n")
    for idx, text, msg in errors:
        out_write(f"\n{text}\n  -> {msg} (Line: {idx})\n")

def cmd_sanity(file_path, args):
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=False)
    now = now_dt()
    sorted_acts = sorted(activities, key=lambda a: a.start.sort_key())
    output_blocks = []
    for pos, act in enumerate(sorted_acts):
        reasons = []
        end_dt = act.end if act.end is not None else now
        if end_dt.sort_key() < act.start.sort_key():
            reasons.append("Activity has negative duration")
        # started before another (earlier in sorted order) activity ended
        started_before_end = False
        for prev in sorted_acts[:pos]:
            if prev.end is not None and prev.end.sort_key() > act.start.sort_key():
                started_before_end = True
                break
        if started_before_end:
            reasons.append("Activity started before another activity ended")
        if reasons:
            output_blocks.append((act, reasons))
    if not output_blocks:
        out_write("No unusual activities.\n")
        return
    for act, reasons in output_blocks:
        for reason in reasons:
            out_write(f"{reason}\n")
        end_str = act.end.format_datetime() if act.end is not None else "--"
        out_write(f"{act.description} (Started: {act.start.format_datetime()}, Ended: {end_str}, Line: {act.line_number})\n\n")

def cmd_edit(file_path, args):
    editor = args.get("editor")
    if editor is None:
        raise BartibError("editor command is missing")
    try:
        subprocess.run([editor, file_path])
    except OSError as e:
        # Rust's Command spawn with an empty program name yields ENOENT
        if editor == "":
            raise BartibError("No such file or directory (os error 2)")
        raise BartibError(format_io_error(e))

def _print_activity_table(headers_rows):
    # helper not used
    pass

def _list_rows_and_colors(acts, now, start_full):
    rows = []
    colors = []
    for act in acts:
        if start_full:
            start_cell = act.start.format_datetime()
        else:
            start_cell = act.start.format_time()
        if act.end is None:
            end_cell = "-"
            color = 32
        else:
            if act.end.date_days() != act.start.date_days():
                end_cell = act.end.format_datetime()
                color = 33
            else:
                end_cell = act.end.format_time()
                color = None
        rows.append([start_cell, end_cell, act.description, act.project, act.get_duration_string(now)])
        colors.append(color)
    return rows, colors

def cmd_list(file_path, args):
    number = parse_number_argument(args.get("number")) if args.get("number") is not None else None
    today = today_days()
    filt = build_filter(args, today)
    round_interval = parse_round_argument(args.get("round")) if args.get("round") is not None else None
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    if round_interval is not None:
        for act in activities:
            round_activity(act, round_interval)
    filtered = filter_activities(activities, filt)
    filtered = sorted(filtered, key=lambda a: a.start.sort_key())
    if number is not None:
        if number == 0:
            filtered = []
        elif number < len(filtered):
            filtered = filtered[len(filtered) - number:]
    if not filtered:
        out_write("No activity to display\n")
        return
    now = now_dt()
    headers = ["Started", "Stopped", "Description", "Project", "Duration"]
    single_date = filt.mode == "date"
    no_grouping = bool(args.get("no_grouping"))
    if single_date:
        rows, colors = _list_rows_and_colors(filtered, now, start_full=False)
        widths = compute_widths(headers, rows)
        out_write("\n")
        out_write(table_header_line(headers, widths))
        for row, color in zip(rows, colors):
            out_write(table_row_line(row, widths, color))
        out_write("\n")
        return
    if no_grouping:
        rows, colors = _list_rows_and_colors(filtered, now, start_full=True)
        widths = compute_widths(headers, rows)
        out_write("\n")
        out_write(table_header_line(headers, widths))
        for row, color in zip(rows, colors):
            out_write(table_row_line(row, widths, color))
        out_write("\n")
        return
    # grouped by start date
    rows_all, colors_all = _list_rows_and_colors(filtered, now, start_full=False)
    widths = compute_widths(headers, rows_all)
    out_write("\n")
    out_write(table_header_line(headers, widths))
    # build groups in ascending date order; filtered is already sorted
    groups = []
    cur_date = None
    cur_items = []
    for act, row, color in zip(filtered, rows_all, colors_all):
        d = act.start.date_days()
        if d != cur_date:
            if cur_items:
                groups.append((cur_date, cur_items))
            cur_date = d
            cur_items = []
        cur_items.append((act, row, color))
    if cur_items:
        groups.append((cur_date, cur_items))
    for d, items in groups:
        total_nanos = sum(act.duration_nanos(now) for act, _r, _c in items)
        y, m, dd = civil_from_days(d)
        date_str = f"{format_year(y)}-{m:02d}-{dd:02d}"
        out_write("\n")
        out_write(f"\x1b[1m{date_str}\t{format_duration_nanos(total_nanos)}\x1b[0m\n")
        for _act, row, color in items:
            out_write(table_row_line(row, widths, color))
    out_write("\n")

def _report_lines(activities, now):
    # returns list of (label, duration_string, is_bold_section)
    by_project = {}
    for act in activities:
        by_project.setdefault(act.project, {}).setdefault(act.description, 0)
        by_project[act.project][act.description] += act.duration_nanos(now)
    projects_sorted = sorted(by_project.keys())
    sections = []  # (project, proj_total_nanos, [(desc, nanos)])
    grand = 0
    for proj in projects_sorted:
        descs = by_project[proj]
        proj_total = sum(descs.values())
        grand += proj_total
        desc_items = [(desc, descs[desc]) for desc in sorted(descs.keys())]
        sections.append((proj, proj_total, desc_items))
    return sections, grand

def cmd_report(file_path, args):
    today = today_days()
    filt = build_filter(args, today)
    round_interval = parse_round_argument(args.get("round")) if args.get("round") is not None else None
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    if round_interval is not None:
        for act in activities:
            round_activity(act, round_interval)
    filtered = filter_activities(activities, filt)
    now = now_dt()
    sections, grand = _report_lines(filtered, now)
    labels = []
    durations = []
    # collect for width computation
    for proj, proj_total, desc_items in sections:
        labels.append(proj)
        durations.append(format_duration_nanos(proj_total))
        for desc, nanos in desc_items:
            labels.append("    " + desc)
            durations.append(format_duration_nanos(nanos))
    labels.append("Total")
    durations.append(format_duration_nanos(grand))
    label_width = max(len(x) for x in labels)
    dur_width = max(len(x) for x in durations)
    def fmt_line(label, nanos, make_bold):
        dur = format_duration_nanos(nanos)
        padded = label + "." * (label_width - len(label)) if len(label) < label_width else label
        line = f"{padded} {dur:>{dur_width}}"
        if make_bold:
            line = bold(line)
        return line + "\n"
    out_write("\n")
    for proj, proj_total, desc_items in sections:
        out_write(fmt_line(proj, proj_total, True))
        for desc, nanos in desc_items:
            out_write(fmt_line("    " + desc, nanos, False))
        out_write("\n")
    out_write(fmt_line("Total", grand, True))
    out_write("\n")

def cmd_status(file_path, args):
    project = args.get("project")
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    now = now_dt()
    today = today_days()
    # filtered by project for all computations
    acts = [a for a in activities if project is None or a.project == project]
    running = [a for a in acts if a.end is None]
    def total_for(date_pred):
        total = 0
        for act in acts:
            if date_pred(act.start.date_days()):
                total += act.duration_nanos(now)
        return total
    monday = _monday_of_week(today)
    y_today, m_today, _d = civil_from_days(today)
    def is_today(d):
        return d == today
    def is_week(d):
        return monday <= d <= monday + 6
    def is_month(d):
        y, m, _dd = civil_from_days(d)
        return y == y_today and m == m_today
    totals = [
        ("Today", total_for(is_today)),
        ("Current week", total_for(is_week)),
        ("Current month", total_for(is_month)),
    ]
    def dim(t):
        return f"\x1b[2m{t}\x1b[0m"
    def italic(t):
        return f"\x1b[3m{t}\x1b[0m"
    def dim_italic(t):
        return f"\x1b[2;3m{t}\x1b[0m"
    def bold_green(t):
        return f"\x1b[1;32m{t}\x1b[0m"
    text = ""
    text += dim("\n =======")
    if project is None:
        text += italic(" Status for ")
        text += bold("ALL")
        text += italic(" projects ")
    else:
        text += italic(" Status for project: ")
        text += bold(project)
    text += dim(" ======= \n")
    if running:
        act = running[0]
        text += dim_italic("\n  NOW: ")
        text += bold_green(act.description)
        if project is None:
            text += dim_italic(" on ")
            text += italic(act.project)
        text += dim(" ...... ")
        text += bold(act.get_duration_string(now))
        text += dim("\n\n")
    else:
        text += dim_italic("\n  NOW: ")
        text += bold(" NO Activity\n\n")
    for label, nanos in totals:
        padded_label = label + "." * (30 - len(label)) if len(label) < 30 else label
        text += italic(" ")
        text += dim_italic(f" {padded_label} ")
        text += bold(format_duration_nanos(nanos))
        text += italic("\n")
    text += "\n"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class ActivityFilter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.mode = "none"  # 'none' | 'date' | 'range'
        self.date = None
        self.from_date = None
        self.to_date = None
        self.project = None

def _monday_of_week(days):
    # weekday: Monday == 0
    wd = (days + 3) % 7
    return days - wd

def build_filter(args, today):
    filt = ActivityFilter()
    filt.project = args.get("project")
    if args.get("date") is not None:
        parsed = parse_date_argument(args.get("date"), "-d/--date")
        if parsed is not None:
            filt.mode = "date"
            filt.date = parsed
        return filt
    if args.get("today"):
        filt.mode = "date"
        filt.date = today
        return filt
    if args.get("yesterday"):
        filt.mode = "date"
        filt.date = today - 1
        return filt
    if args.get("current_week"):
        monday = _monday_of_week(today)
        filt.mode = "range"
        filt.from_date = monday
        filt.to_date = monday + 6
        return filt
    if args.get("last_week"):
        monday = _monday_of_week(today) - 7
        filt.mode = "range"
        filt.from_date = monday
        filt.to_date = monday + 6
        return filt
    if args.get("from") is not None or args.get("to") is not None:
        filt.mode = "range"
        if args.get("from") is not None:
            filt.from_date = parse_date_argument(args.get("from"), "--from")
        if args.get("to") is not None:
            filt.to_date = parse_date_argument(args.get("to"), "--to")
        return filt
    return filt

def filter_activities(activities, filt):
    result = []
    for act in activities:
        if filt.project is not None and act.project != filt.project:
            continue
        d = act.start.date_days()
        if filt.mode == "date":
            if d != filt.date:
                continue
        elif filt.mode == "range":
            if filt.from_date is not None and d < filt.from_date:
                continue
            if filt.to_date is not None and d > filt.to_date:
                continue
        result.append(act)
    return result

def get_unique_activities(activities):
    sorted_acts = sorted(activities, key=lambda a: a.start.sort_key())
    seen = set()
    unique = []
    for act in reversed(sorted_acts):
        key = (act.description, act.project)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        unique.append(act)
    return unique

def _stop_lines(lines, end_dt, emit_second_warning=True):
    new_lines = []
    for line in lines:
        try:

        except ActivityParseError:
            new_lines.append(line)
            continue
        if act.end is None:
            act.end = end_dt
            dur = format_duration_nanos(act.end.total_nanos() - act.start.total_nanos())
            out_write(f'Stopped activity: "{act.description}" ({act.project}) started at {act.start.format_datetime()} ({dur})\n')
            new_lines.append(activity_to_line(act))
        else:

    return new_lines

    project = args.get("project") if args.get("project") is not None else selected.project

    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    unique = get_unique_activities(activities)
    term_lower = term.lower()
    matched = []
    for idx, act in enumerate(unique):
        if term_lower in act.description.lower() or term_lower in act.project.lower():

def cmd_sanity(file_path, args):

    now = now_dt()
    sorted_acts = sorted(activities, key=lambda a: a.start.sort_key())
    output_blocks = []
    for pos, act in enumerate(sorted_acts):
        reasons = []
        end_dt = act.end if act.end is not None else now
        if end_dt.sort_key() < act.start.sort_key():
            reasons.append("Activity has negative duration")
        # started before another (earlier in sorted order) activity ended
        started_before_end = False
        for prev in sorted_acts[:pos]:
            if prev.end is not None and prev.end.sort_key() > act.start.sort_key():
                started_before_end = True
                break
        if started_before_end:
            reasons.append("Activity started before another activity ended")
        if reasons:
            output_blocks.append((act, reasons))
    if not output_blocks:
        out_write("No unusual activities.\n")
        return
    for act, reasons in output_blocks:
        for reason in reasons:
            out_write(f"{reason}\n")
        end_str = act.end.format_datetime() if act.end is not None else "--"

def _report_lines(activities, now):
    # returns list of (label, duration_string, is_bold_section)
    by_project = {}
    for act in activities:
        by_project.setdefault(act.project, {}).setdefault(act.description, 0)
        by_project[act.project][act.description] += act.duration_nanos(now)
    projects_sorted = sorted(by_project.keys())
    sections = []  # (project, proj_total_nanos, [(desc, nanos)])
    grand = 0
    for proj in projects_sorted:
        descs = by_project[proj]
        proj_total = sum(descs.values())
        grand += proj_total
        desc_items = [(desc, descs[desc]) for desc in sorted(descs.keys())]
        sections.append((proj, proj_total, desc_items))
    return sections, grand

    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)

    filtered = filter_activities(activities, filt)
    now = now_dt()
    sections, grand = _report_lines(filtered, now)
    labels = []
    durations = []
    # collect for width computation
    for proj, proj_total, desc_items in sections:
        labels.append(proj)
        durations.append(format_duration_nanos(proj_total))
        for desc, nanos in desc_items:
            labels.append("    " + desc)
            durations.append(format_duration_nanos(nanos))
    labels.append("Total")
    durations.append(format_duration_nanos(grand))
    label_width = max(len(x) for x in labels)
    dur_width = max(len(x) for x in durations)
    def fmt_line(label, nanos, make_bold):
        dur = format_duration_nanos(nanos)
        padded = label + "." * (label_width - len(label)) if len(label) < label_width else label
        line = f"{padded} {dur:>{dur_width}}"
        if make_bold:
            line = bold(line)
        return line + "\n"
    out_write("\n")
    for proj, proj_total, desc_items in sections:
        out_write(fmt_line(proj, proj_total, True))
        for desc, nanos in desc_items:
            out_write(fmt_line("    " + desc, nanos, False))
        out_write("\n")
    out_write(fmt_line("Total", grand, True))
    out_write("\n")

def cmd_status(file_path, args):
    project = args.get("project")
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    now = now_dt()
    today = today_days()
    # filtered by project for all computations
    acts = [a for a in activities if project is None or a.project == project]
    running = [a for a in acts if a.end is None]
    def total_for(date_pred):
        total = 0
        for act in acts:
            if date_pred(act.start.date_days()):
                total += act.duration_nanos(now)
        return total
    monday = _monday_of_week(today)
    y_today, m_today, _d = civil_from_days(today)
    def is_today(d):
        return d == today
    def is_week(d):
        return monday <= d <= monday + 6
    def is_month(d):
        y, m, _dd = civil_from_days(d)
        return y == y_today and m == m_today
    totals = [
        ("Today", total_for(is_today)),
        ("Current week", total_for(is_week)),
        ("Current month", total_for(is_month)),
    ]
    def dim(t):
        return f"\x1b[2m{t}\x1b[0m"
    def italic(t):
        return f"\x1b[3m{t}\x1b[0m"
    def dim_italic(t):
        return f"\x1b[2;3m{t}\x1b[0m"
    def bold_green(t):
        return f"\x1b[1;32m{t}\x1b[0m"
    text = ""
    text += dim("\n =======")
    if project is None:
        text += italic(" Status for ")
        text += bold("ALL")
        text += italic(" projects ")
    else:
        text += italic(" Status for project: ")
        text += bold(project)
    text += dim(" ======= \n")
    if running:
        act = running[0]
        text += dim_italic("\n  NOW: ")
        text += bold_green(act.description)
        if project is None:
            text += dim_italic(" on ")
            text += italic(act.project)
        text += dim(" ...... ")
        text += bold(act.get_duration_string(now))
        text += dim("\n\n")
    else:
        text += dim_italic("\n  NOW: ")
        text += bold(" NO Activity\n\n")
    for label, nanos in totals:
        padded_label = label + "." * (30 - len(label)) if len(label) < 30 else label
        text += italic(" ")
        text += dim_italic(f" {padded_label} ")
        text += bold(format_duration_nanos(nanos))
        text += italic("\n")
    text += "\n"
    out_write(text)

    new_start = datetime_opt_from_time_argument(args.get("time"))
    new_desc = args.get("description")
    new_project = args.get("project")
    lines = read_lines(file_path)
    has_change = new_desc is not None or new_project is not None or new_start is not None
    new_lines = []
    for line in lines:
        try:
            act = parse_activity(line)
        except ActivityParseError:
            new_lines.append(line)
            continue
        if act.end is None and has_change:
            if new_desc is not None:
                act.description = new_desc
            if new_project is not None:
                act.project = new_project
            if new_start is not None:
                act.start = new_start
            out_write(f'Changed activity: "{act.description}" ({act.project}) started at {act.start.format_datetime()}\n')
            new_lines.append(activity_to_line(act))
        else:
            new_lines.append(line)
    write_lines(file_path, new_lines)

def cmd_continue(file_path, args):
    dt = datetime_from_time_argument(args.get("time"))
    number = parse_number_argument(args.get("number"))
    if number is None:
        number = 0
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    unique = get_unique_activities(activities)
    if not unique:
        raise BartibError("No activity has been started before.")
    if number > len(unique):
        raise BartibError(f"Less than {number} distinct activities have been logged yet")
    selected = unique[number] if number < len(unique) else unique[-1]
    description = args.get("description") if args.get("description") is not None else selected.description
    project = args.get("project") if args.get("project") is not None else selected.project
    # Start the new activity.  The file has already been parsed once
    # above, so the line-processing pass must not emit the
    # second-precision warnings a second time.
    lines = read_lines_or_empty(file_path)
    new_lines = _stop_lines(lines, dt, emit_second_warning=False)
    act = Activity(dt, None, project, description)
    new_lines.append(activity_to_line(act))
    out_write(f'Started activity: "{act.description}" ({act.project}) at {act.start.format_datetime()}\n')
    write_lines(file_path, new_lines)

def cmd_current(file_path, args):
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    now = now_dt()
    running = [a for a in activities if a.end is None]
    if not running:
        out_write("No Activity is currently running\n")
        return
    rows = []
    for act in running:
        rows.append([act.start.format_datetime(), act.description, act.project, act.get_duration_string(now)])
    print_table(["Started At", "Description", "Project", "Duration"], rows)

def cmd_last(file_path, args):
    number = parse_number_argument(args.get("number"))
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    unique = get_unique_activities(activities)
    if number is not None:
        unique = unique[:number]
    if not unique:
        out_write("No activities have been tracked yet\n")
        return
    indexed = list(enumerate(unique))
    rows = []
    for idx, act in reversed(indexed):
        rows.append([f"[{idx}]", act.description, act.project])
    print_table([" #", "Description", "Project"], rows)

def cmd_search(file_path, args):
    term = args.get("search_term") or ""
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    unique = get_unique_activities(activities)
    term_lower = term.lower()
    matched = []
    for idx, act in enumerate(unique):
        if term_lower in act.description.lower() or term_lower in act.project.lower():
            matched.append((idx, act))
    if not matched:
        out_write("No matching activities found\n")
        return
    rows = []
    for idx, act in reversed(matched):
        rows.append([f"[{idx}]", act.description, act.project])
    print_table([" #", "Description", "Project"], rows)

def cmd_projects(file_path, args):
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    if args.get("current"):
        acts = [a for a in activities if a.end is None]
    else:
        acts = activities
    projects = sorted(set(a.project for a in acts))
    no_quotes = args.get("no-quotes") or args.get("no_quotes")
    for proj in projects:
        if no_quotes:
            out_write(f"{proj}\n")
        else:
            out_write(f'"{proj}"\n')

def cmd_check(file_path, args):
    lines = read_lines(file_path)
    errors = []
    for idx, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
        try:
            parse_activity(line, idx)
        except ActivityParseError as e:
            errors.append((idx, line.strip(), e.message()))
    if not errors:
        out_write("All lines in the file have been successfully parsed as activities.\n")
        return
    out_write(f"Found {len(errors)} line(s) with parsing errors\n")
    for idx, text, msg in errors:
        out_write(f"\n{text}\n  -> {msg} (Line: {idx})\n")

def cmd_sanity(file_path, args):
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=False)
    now = now_dt()
    sorted_acts = sorted(activities, key=lambda a: a.start.sort_key())
    output_blocks = []
    for pos, act in enumerate(sorted_acts):
        reasons = []
        end_dt = act.end if act.end is not None else now
        if end_dt.sort_key() < act.start.sort_key():
            reasons.append("Activity has negative duration")
        # started before another (earlier in sorted order) activity ended
        started_before_end = False
        for prev in sorted_acts[:pos]:
            if prev.end is not None and prev.end.sort_key() > act.start.sort_key():
                started_before_end = True
                break
        if started_before_end:
            reasons.append("Activity started before another activity ended")
        if reasons:
            output_blocks.append((act, reasons))
    if not output_blocks:
        out_write("No unusual activities.\n")
        return
    for act, reasons in output_blocks:
        for reason in reasons:
            out_write(f"{reason}\n")
        end_str = act.end.format_datetime() if act.end is not None else "--"
        out_write(f"{act.description} (Started: {act.start.format_datetime()}, Ended: {end_str}, Line: {act.line_number})\n\n")

def cmd_edit(file_path, args):
    editor = args.get("editor")
    if editor is None:
        raise BartibError("editor command is missing")
    try:
        subprocess.run([editor, file_path])
    except OSError as e:
        # Rust's Command spawn with an empty program name yields ENOENT
        if editor == "":
            raise BartibError("No such file or directory (os error 2)")
        raise BartibError(format_io_error(e))

def _list_rows_and_colors(acts, now, start_full):
    rows = []
    colors = []
    for act in acts:
        if start_full:
            start_cell = act.start.format_datetime()
        else:
            start_cell = act.start.format_time()
        if act.end is None:
            end_cell = "-"
            color = 32
        else:
            if act.end.date_days() != act.start.date_days():
                end_cell = act.end.format_datetime()
                color = 33
            else:
                end_cell = act.end.format_time()

def cmd_list(file_path, args):
    number = parse_number_argument(args.get("number")) if args.get("number") is not None else None
    today = today_days()
    filt = build_filter(args, today)
    round_interval = parse_round_argument(args.get("round")) if args.get("round") is not None else None
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    if round_interval is not None:
        for act in activities:
            round_activity(act, round_interval)
    filtered = filter_activities(activities, filt)
    filtered = sorted(filtered, key=lambda a: a.start.sort_key())
    if number is not None:
        if number == 0:
            filtered = []
        elif number < len(filtered):
            filtered = filtered[len(filtered) - number:]
    if not filtered:
        out_write("No activity to display\n")
        return
    now = now_dt()
    headers = ["Started", "Stopped", "Description", "Project", "Duration"]
    single_date = filt.mode == "date"
    no_grouping = bool(args.get("no_grouping"))
    if single_date:
        rows, colors = _list_rows_and_colors(filtered, now, start_full=False)
        widths = compute_widths(headers, rows)
        out_write("\n")
        out_write(table_header_line(headers, widths))
        for row, color in zip(rows, colors):
            out_write(table_row_line(row, widths, color))
        out_write("\n")
        return
    if no_grouping:
        rows, colors = _list_rows_and_colors(filtered, now, start_full=True)
        widths = compute_widths(headers, rows)
        out_write("\n")
        out_write(table_header_line(headers, widths))
        for row, color in zip(rows, colors):
            out_write(table_row_line(row, widths, color))
        out_write("\n")
        return
    # grouped by start date
    rows_all, colors_all = _list_rows_and_colors(filtered, now, start_full=False)
    widths = compute_widths(headers, rows_all)
    out_write("\n")
    out_write(table_header_line(headers, widths))
    # build groups in ascending date order; filtered is already sorted
    groups = []
    cur_date = None
    cur_items = []
    for act, row, color in zip(filtered, rows_all, colors_all):
        d = act.start.date_days()
        if d != cur_date:
            if cur_items:
                groups.append((cur_date, cur_items))
            cur_date = d
            cur_items = []
        cur_items.append((act, row, color))
    if cur_items:
        groups.append((cur_date, cur_items))
    for d, items in groups:
        total_nanos = sum(act.duration_nanos(now) for act, _r, _c in items)
        y, m, dd = civil_from_days(d)
        date_str = f"{format_year(y)}-{m:02d}-{dd:02d}"
        out_write("\n")
        out_write(f"\x1b[1m{date_str}\t{format_duration_nanos(total_nanos)}\x1b[0m\n")
        for _act, row, color in items:
            out_write(table_row_line(row, widths, color))
    out_write("\n")

def _report_lines(activities, now):
    # returns list of (label, duration_string, is_bold_section)
    by_project = {}
    for act in activities:
        by_project.setdefault(act.project, {}).setdefault(act.description, 0)
        by_project[act.project][act.description] += act.duration_nanos(now)
    projects_sorted = sorted(by_project.keys())
    sections = []  # (project, proj_total_nanos, [(desc, nanos)])
    grand = 0
    for proj in projects_sorted:
        descs = by_project[proj]
        proj_total = sum(descs.values())
        grand += proj_total
        desc_items = [(desc, descs[desc]) for desc in sorted(descs.keys())]
        sections.append((proj, proj_total, desc_items))
    return sections, grand

def cmd_report(file_path, args):
    today = today_days()
    filt = build_filter(args, today)
    round_interval = parse_round_argument(args.get("round")) if args.get("round") is not None else None
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    if round_interval is not None:
        for act in activities:
            round_activity(act, round_interval)
    filtered = filter_activities(activities, filt)
    now = now_dt()
    sections, grand = _report_lines(filtered, now)
    labels = []
    durations = []
    # collect for width computation
    for proj, proj_total, desc_items in sections:
        labels.append(proj)
        durations.append(format_duration_nanos(proj_total))
        for desc, nanos in desc_items:
            labels.append("    " + desc)
            durations.append(format_duration_nanos(nanos))
    labels.append("Total")
    durations.append(format_duration_nanos(grand))
    label_width = max(len(x) for x in labels)
    dur_width = max(len(x) for x in durations)
    def fmt_line(label, nanos, make_bold):
        dur = format_duration_nanos(nanos)
        padded = label + "." * (label_width - len(label)) if len(label) < label_width else label
        line = f"{padded} {dur:>{dur_width}}"
        if make_bold:
            line = bold(line)
        return line + "\n"
    out_write("\n")
    for proj, proj_total, desc_items in sections:
        out_write(fmt_line(proj, proj_total, True))
        for desc, nanos in desc_items:
            out_write(fmt_line("    " + desc, nanos, False))
        out_write("\n")
    out_write(fmt_line("Total", grand, True))
    out_write("\n")

def cmd_status(file_path, args):
    project = args.get("project")
    activities = get_activities(file_path, print_warnings=True)
    now = now_dt()
    today = today_days()
    # filtered by project for all computations
    acts = [a for a in activities if project is None or a.project == project]
    running = [a for a in acts if a.end is None]
    def total_for(date_pred):
        total = 0
        for act in acts:
            if date_pred(act.start.date_days()):
                total += act.duration_nanos(now)
        return total
    monday = _monday_of_week(today)
    y_today, m_today, _d = civil_from_days(today)
    def is_today(d):
        return d == today
    def is_week(d):
        return monday <= d <= monday + 6
    def is_month(d):
        y, m, _dd = civil_from_days(d)
        return y == y_today and m == m_today
    totals = [
        ("Today", total_for(is_today)),
        ("Current week", total_for(is_week)),
        ("Current month", total_for(is_month)),
    ]
    def dim(t):
        return f"\x1b[2m{t}\x1b[0m"
    def italic(t):
        return f"\x1b[3m{t}\x1b[0m"
    def dim_italic(t):
        return f"\x1b[2;3m{t}\x1b[0m"
    def bold_green(t):
        return f"\x1b[1;32m{t}\x1b[0m"
    text = ""
    text += dim("\n =======")
    if project is None:
        text += italic(" Status for ")
        text += bold("ALL")
        text += italic(" projects ")
    else:
        text += italic(" Status for project: ")
        text += bold(project)
    text += dim(" ======= \n")
    if running:
        act = running[0]
        text += dim_italic("\n  NOW: ")
        text += bold_green(act.description)
        if project is None:
            text += dim_italic(" on ")
            text += italic(act.project)
        text += dim(" ...... ")
        text += bold(act.get_duration_string(now))
        text += dim("\n\n")
    else:
        text += dim_italic("\n  NOW: ")
        text += bold(" NO Activity\n\n")
    for label, nanos in totals:
        padded_label = label + "." * (30 - len(label)) if len(label) < 30 else label
        text += italic(" ")
        text += dim_italic(f" {padded_label} ")
        text += bold(format_duration_nanos(nanos))
        text += italic("\n")
    text += "\n"
    out_write(text)

SUBCOMMANDS = ["cancel", "change", "check", "continue", "current", "edit", "help", "last", "list", "projects", "report", "sanity", "search", "start", "status", "stop"]

class Arg:
    def __init__(self, id, kind, short=None, long=None, value_name=None, required=False, default=None, conflicts=(), optional_value=False):
        self.id = id
        self.kind = kind  # flag | option | positional
        self.short = short
        self.long = long
        self.value_name = value_name
        self.required = required
        self.default = default
        self.conflicts = tuple(conflicts)
        self.optional_value = optional_value

    def usage_fragment(self):
        if self.kind == "flag":
            return f"--{self.long}" if self.long else f"-{self.short}"
        # option
        if self.long:
            return f"--{self.long} <{self.value_name}>"
        return f"-{self.short} <{self.value_name}>"

    def sort_key(self):
        return self.long if self.long else self.id

def _help_arg():
    return Arg("help", "flag", short="h", long="help")

_DATE_FILTER_IDS = ["date", "from", "to", "today", "yesterday", "current_week", "last_week"]

def _filter_conflicts(my_id):
    # every date-filter argument conflicts with every other, except
    # that --from and --to can be combined
    result = []
    for other in _DATE_FILTER_IDS:
        if other == my_id:
            continue
        if set((my_id, other)) == set(("from", "to")):
            continue
        result.append(other)
    return result

def _make_args(ids_with_args):
    return ids_with_args

class Arg:
    def __init__(self, id, kind, short=None, long=None, value_name=None, required=False, default=None, conflicts=(), optional_value=False):
        self.id = id
        self.kind = kind  # flag | option | positional
        self.short = short
        self.long = long
        self.value_name = value_name
        self.required = required
        self.default = default
        self.conflicts = tuple(conflicts)
        self.optional_value = optional_value

    def usage_fragment(self):
        if self.kind == "flag":
            return f"--{self.long}" if self.long else f"-{self.short}"
        # option
        if self.long:
            return f"--{self.long} <{self.value_name}>"
        return f"-{self.short} <{self.value_name}>"

    def sort_key(self):
        return self.long if self.long else self.id

# jaro-winkler (as used by strsim / clap suggestions)

def _jaro(s1, s2):
    if s1 == s2:
        return 1.0
    len1 = len(s1)
    len2 = len(s2)
    if len1 == 0 or len2 == 0:
        return 0.0
    match_distance = max(len1, len2) // 2 - 1
    if match_distance < 0:
        match_distance = 0
    s1_matches = [False] * len1
    s2_matches = [False] * len2
    matches = 0
    for i in range(len1):
        start = max(0, i - match_distance)
        end = min(i + match_distance + 1, len2)
        for j in range(start, end):
            if s2_matches[j] or s1[i] != s2[j]:
                continue
            s1_matches[i] = True
            s2_matches[j] = True
            matches += 1
            break
    if matches == 0:
        return 0.0
    k = 0
    transpositions = 0
    for i in range(len1):
        if not s1_matches[i]:
            continue
        while not s2_matches[k]:
            k += 1
        if s1[i] != s2[k]:
            transpositions += 1
        k += 1
    transpositions //= 2
    return (matches / len1 + matches / len2 + (matches - transpositions) / matches) / 3.0

def _jaro_winkler(s1, s2):
    j = _jaro(s1, s2)
    if j > 0.7:
        prefix = 0
        for a, b in zip(s1, s2):
            if a == b and prefix < 4:
                prefix += 1
            else:
                break
        j += prefix * 0.1 * (1 - j)
    return j

def _did_you_mean(value, candidates):
    best = None
    best_conf = 0.0
    for cand in candidates:
        conf = _jaro_winkler(value, cand)
        if conf > 0.8 and (best is None or conf > best_conf):
            best = cand
            best_conf = conf
    return best

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Top-level parsing and entry point
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _invalid_subcommand_error(bin_name, token, used_ids, top_map):
    candidate = _did_you_mean(token, SUBCOMMANDS)
    if candidate is None:
        _unknown_argument_error(bin_name, "__top__", token, used_ids, top_map, None)
    usage = _error_usage(bin_name, "__top__", used_ids, top_map)
    text = (
        f"error: The subcommand '{token}' wasn't recognized\n"
        f"\tDid you mean '{candidate}'?\n"
        f"\nIf you believe you received this message in error, try re-running with '{bin_name} -- {token}'\n"
        f"\nUSAGE:\n    {usage}\n\nFor more information try --help\n"
    )
    raise ClapError(text)

def _handle_help_subcommand(bin_name, tokens):
    if not tokens:
        raise HelpDisplay(main_help(bin_name))
    if len(tokens) == 1:
        token = tokens[0]
        if token in SUBCOMMANDS:
            raise HelpDisplay(sub_help(bin_name, token))
        raise ClapError(f"error: The subcommand '{token}' wasn't recognized\n\nUSAGE:\n\t{bin_name} help <subcommands>...\n\nFor more information try --help\n")
    token = tokens[1]
    raise ClapError(f"error: The subcommand '{token}' wasn't recognized\n\nUSAGE:\n\t{bin_name} help <subcommands>...\n\nFor more information try --help\n")

def run_cli(bin_name, tokens):
    file_arg = Arg("file", "option", "f", None, "FILE")
    help_arg = _help_arg()
    version_arg = Arg("version", "flag", "V", "version")
    top_map = {"file": file_arg, "help": help_arg, "version": version_arg}
    top_by_long = {"help": help_arg, "version": version_arg}
    top_by_short = {"f": file_arg, "h": help_arg, "V": version_arg}
    file_occurrences = 0
    file_value = None
    used_ids = set()
    selected = None
    rest = []
    after_dashdash = False
    i = 0
    n = len(tokens)
    while i < n:
        token = tokens[i]
        if after_dashdash:
            _invalid_subcommand_error(bin_name, token, set(used_ids), top_map)

            after_dashdash = True
            i += 1
            continue
        if token in SUBCOMMANDS:
            selected = token
            rest = tokens[i + 1:]
            break

            if "=" in body:
                name = body.split("=", 1)[0]
            else:

            arg = top_by_long.get(name)
            if arg is None:
                cand_long = _did_you_mean(name, ["help", "version"])
                cand_arg = top_by_long.get(cand_long) if cand_long else None
                _unknown_argument_error(bin_name, "__top__", f"--{name}", set(used_ids), top_map, cand_arg)

                raise HelpDisplay(main_help(bin_name))
            if arg.id == "version":
                raise HelpDisplay(f"bartib {VERSION}\n")

            continue
        if len(token) > 1 and token.startswith("-"):
            chars = token[1:]
            j = 0
            consumed_next = False
            while j < len(chars):
                c = chars[j]
                arg = top_by_short.get(c)
                if arg is None:
                    _unknown_argument_error(bin_name, "__top__", f"-{c}", set(used_ids), top_map, None)
                if arg.id == "help":
                    raise HelpDisplay(main_help(bin_name))
                if arg.id == "version":
                    raise HelpDisplay(f"bartib {VERSION}\n")
                # file option
                used_ids.add("file")
                file_occurrences += 1
                rest_of_cluster = chars[j + 1:]
                if rest_of_cluster != "":
                    file_value = rest_of_cluster[1:] if rest_of_cluster.startswith("=") else rest_of_cluster
                elif i + 1 < n and _can_be_value(tokens[i + 1]):

    if file_occurrences > 1:

        raise ClapError(_clap_error_text("error: The argument '-f <FILE>' was provided more than once, but cannot be used multiple times", usage))

        file_path = os.environ["BARTIB_FILE"]
    else:

    if file_path is None:
        raise BartibError("Please specify a file with your activity log either as -f option or as BARTIB_FILE environment variable")

        "start": cmd_start,
        "stop": cmd_stop,
        "cancel": cmd_cancel,
        "change": cmd_change,
        "continue": cmd_continue,
        "current": cmd_current,
        "last": cmd_last,
        "search": cmd_search,
        "projects": cmd_projects,
        "check": cmd_check,
        "sanity": cmd_sanity,
        "edit": cmd_edit,
        "list": cmd_list,
        "report": cmd_report,
        "status": cmd_status,
    }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Report label wrapping (wide characters)
#
# The original report formatter wraps a project / description label at
# the (character-count) maximum label width, measured in terminal
# display columns.  For plain ASCII this never triggers, but wide
# (CJK / emoji) characters can exceed that width and are then broken
# across lines; the final line is padded with dots.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

import unicodedata

def _char_display_width(ch):
    if unicodedata.combining(ch):
        return 0
    if unicodedata.category(ch) in ("Mn", "Me", "Cf"):
        return 0
    if unicodedata.east_asian_width(ch) in ("W", "F"):
        return 2
    if ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127:
        return 0
    return 1

def _display_width(s):
    return sum(_char_display_width(c) for c in s)

def _wrap_label(label, width):
    if _display_width(label) <= width:
        return [label]
    stripped = label.lstrip(" ")
    indent = label[:len(label) - len(stripped)]
    content = stripped
    avail = width - _display_width(indent)
    if avail < 1:
        avail = 1
    segments = []
    start = 0
    n = len(content)
    while start < n:
        # skip spaces at the start of a continuation segment
        while start < n and content[start] == " ":
            start += 1
        if start >= n:
            break
        # farthest end that fits
        w = 0
        end = start
        while end < n:
            cw = _char_display_width(content[end])
            if w + cw > avail:
                break
            w += cw
            end += 1
        if end >= n:
            segments.append(content[start:].rstrip(" "))
            break
        # find last break opportunity in (start, end]
        seg_end = None
        next_start = None
        pos = end
        while pos > start:
            # break after a space
            if content[pos - 1] == " ":
                seg_end = pos - 1
                next_start = pos
                break
            # break between characters if either side is wide
            if pos < n and (_char_display_width(content[pos - 1]) == 2 or _char_display_width(content[pos]) == 2):
                seg_end = pos
                next_start = pos
                break
            if content[pos - 1] == "-":
                seg_end = pos
                next_start = pos
                break
            pos -= 1
        if seg_end is None or seg_end <= start:
            seg_end = end
            next_start = end
        segments.append(content[start:seg_end].rstrip(" "))
        start = next_start
    if not segments:
        return [label]
    return [indent + seg for seg in segments]

import pty, os, subprocess, struct, fcntl, termios
def run_pty(cols,args):
    # create pty pair
    import os
    pid, fd = pty.fork()
    if pid==0:
        os.execv("/workspace/executable", ["/workspace/executable"]+args)
    else:
        # set window size
        fcntl.ioctl(fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack("HHHH",24,cols,0,0))
        out=b""
        while True:
            try:
                data=os.read(fd,4096)
            except OSError:
                break
            if not data: break
            out+=data
        os.waitpid(pid,0)
        return out
for cols in [40,80,200]:
    print("COLS",cols)
    print(run_pty(cols,["list","--help"]).decode())

def _wrap_label(label, width):
    if _display_width(label) <= width:
        return [label]
    stripped = label.lstrip(" ")
    indent = label[:len(label) - len(stripped)]
    content = stripped
    avail = width - _display_width(indent)
    if avail < 1:
        avail = 1
    segments = []
    start = 0
    n = len(content)
    while start < n:
        # skip spaces at the start of a continuation segment
        while start < n and content[start] == " ":
            start += 1
        if start >= n:
            break
        # farthest end that fits
        w = 0
        end = start
        while end < n:
            cw = _char_display_width(content[end])
            if w + cw > avail:
                break
            w += cw
            end += 1
        if end >= n:
            segments.append(content[start:].rstrip(" "))
            break
        # find last break opportunity in (start, end]
        seg_end = None
        next_start = None
        pos = end
        while pos > start:
            # break after a space
            if content[pos - 1] == " ":
                seg_end = pos - 1
                next_start = pos
                break
            # break between characters if either side is wide
            if pos < n and (_char_display_width(content[pos - 1]) == 2 or _char_display_width(content[pos]) == 2):
                seg_end = pos
                next_start = pos
                break
            if content[pos - 1] == "-":
                seg_end = pos
                next_start = pos
                break
            pos -= 1
        if seg_end is None or seg_end <= start:
            seg_end = end
            next_start = end
        segments.append(content[start:seg_end].rstrip(" "))
        start = next_start
    if not segments:
        return [label]
    return [indent + seg for seg in segments]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
